note: The stance array inherits an option-matching defect whose signature is option_logprobs[0] == option_logprobs[4] == max(option_logprobs): it marks 18,420 of the 75,867 non-refused rows (24.3%), of which 77.8% open with an explicit agree or disagree in the free text. Recompute from justification, not from option_logprobs. See the "Two bugs we found in our own code" section of the top-level README.md.
derived: Only pos_reflection.bin ships. The other seven arrays named below are a convenience cache and were removed to keep the release minimal; every one of them rebuilds from data/responses.jsonl.gz (five bit-for-bit, the two other layouts to float32 rounding) using the recipe in README.md. The names and dtypes are kept here so a rebuild writes the same filenames.
